3.desc:
Egg Roll by Agri Kind is a dessert-forward, indica-dominant hybrid (roughly 70% indica) crafted from the celebrated cross of Chemdawg and Biscotti. This boutique strain earns its name from its distinctive, tightly packed buds that resemble savory egg rolls—dense, resinous, and layered with trichomes.

Appearance & Aroma
Agri Kind’s Egg Roll showcases bright emerald-green nugs accented by deep purple leaves and thin, fiery orange pistils, all blanketed in a frosty, shimmering coat of white crystal trichomes. Its aroma is a playful fusion of sweet, fruity plum and savory culinary spice, underscored by notes of black pepper, earthy sage, and a subtle diesel-gas finish.

Flavor & Effects
On the palate, Egg Roll delivers a smooth, dessert-like experience: upfront sweetness of ripe plum and berry gives way to a peppery, herbal exhale with hints of earthy spice and faint citrus. Effects begin with a euphoric, giggly head buzz that melts into deep, full-body relaxation—often culminating in couch-lock and dreamy sedation. Ideal for evening use, it’s favored for stress relief, anxiety management, chronic pain, muscle spasms, and insomnia.

Under standard daylight, the piece boasts intricate psychedelic linework; once illuminated by a blacklight, the design instantly shifts into a glowing neon tribute.

This artisan pipe features a direct-airflow, straight-tube design crafted for solo sessions and effortless on-the-go travel. The thick glass walls provide superior heat resistance and structural durability, balancing a comfortable weight in the hand with pristine, flavor-focused draws

This pocket-sized collector's piece features intricate, hand-woven "wig wag" reorig linework—a complex glassblowing technique requiring the artist to repeatedly heat, twist, stack, and reverse fine colored glass rods. The result is a stunning, high-contrast geometric pattern with incredible visual depth wrapped around a classic, durable silhouette.

Engineered for portability and effortless daily use, this chillum features a straight-tube, direct airway design that sits comfortably in the hand. The extra-thick glass construction provides superior thermal resistance and protection against accidental drops, making it a rugged, flavor-focused conversation piece built to go anywhere.

135.desc:
We are committed to providing our guests with medicinally potent products that harness the remarkable healing potential of cannabis. Rick Simpson Oil (RSO) is a potent, full spectrum extract that may capture a more complete range of the beneficial compounds in cannabis than other forms of extract. Pioneered by Rick Simpson during his battle with basal cell carcinoma, RSO gained acclaim as he attributed his recovery to its use and began sharing his discovery publicly. His work helped propel global awareness and advocacy for the medicinal potential of cannabis.

We begin with the full spectrum extraction of cured premium cannabis material. We fill fine mesh bags with cannabis and load them into our extractor with food-grade ethanol. The ethanol extracts cannabinoids and terpenes in addition to other beneficial botanical compounds to capture the full spectrum profile of the plant. We filter the solution to remove any undesirable biomass or compounds and then remove all of the ethanol using a combination of vacuum and heat to distill the alcohol from the extract.

After the ethanol is completely removed, we decarboxylate the oil. This chemical reaction occurs when we apply heat to the cannabinoid acids in the extract, such as THCA or CBDA, which are the non-psychoactive precursors found in raw cannabis. In doing so, we are converting our precursor cannabinoid acids to psychoactive compounds like delta 9 THC and CBD, respectively. The decarboxylation step is crucial to activate the beneficial effects of the final product for ingestion or topical use. This final processing step produces the dark, highly pure and potent RSO.

Our filtered and decarbed full-spectrum RSO is now ready to be either added into edibles or packaged into dispensers for wide-use applications. 

RSO can be ingested or applied topically. Due to the oil’s high concentration of plant waxes and fats, it should NOT be dabbed, smoked, or vaporized. One of the most popular and effective ways to take RSO is through sublingual administration – placing it under the tongue. The mouth’s mucus membranes allow for rapid absorption of cannabinoids directly into the bloodstream.

Please note that this is a very potent product, and we highly recommend discussing dosage and administration with a budtender if you are new to RSO.

Our selected phenotype grows with moderate vigor and a healthy spread of branches that bloom conical, Christmas tree-shaped flowers. Expect a slightly sour, diesel fuel-tinged aroma upfront from the Headband lineage, followed by a heavy-hitting chemical cleaner and fuel finish - classic ChemD.

The Hawaiian-bred Skunkdog Bx1, a staple strain on the islands, is known for its ability to withstand high humidity and thrive in even the wettest climates. Ice Cream Bananaz, the focus of our 2024 Pheno Hunt, shares its roots with Strawberry Cherry Pie and Sugarloaf Pineapple, as all three strains originate from 808 Genetics’ 2021 Strawberry Runtz menu. Despite having a parent in common, Sugarloaf Pineapple, Strawberry Cherry Pie, and Ice Cream Bananaz all yield wildly different results through the diversity of their maternal genetics. In the case of Ice Cream Bananaz, the mother strain, Ice Cream Nana, was introduced to enhance and amplify the foundation of Strawberry Runtz. It’s well worth getting to know all of the phenos in our hunt, as each is a unique expression of this cross.

Phenotype #46 of Ice Cream Bananaz is closely aligned to the paternal lineage of the cross and, more specifically, to its grandfather, Runtz. Commonly known in cannabis forums as the improved Gelato, Runtz is beloved for its sweet, juicy aromas and nostalgic fruit candy flavors. Looking and tasting like sugar-frosted candy, #46’s buds check all the right Runtz boxes and may provide an uplifting and euphoric experience to match.

143.desc:
Watermelon Zkittlez x Pie Eyed

Springing from the well that never seems to run dry, Watermelon Otai comes from a breeder that is likely already familiar to Breakwater regulars – “Maine-stay” Crystal Rose Seed Co. Our team’s success with Crystal Rose projects like Pie Eyed and Wave Runners has fueled our anticipation of yet another standout cross from this dynamic duo.

As fruit-dominant flavors seem to multiply exponentially with each passing year, watermelon has proven to be an elusive and coveted flavor that is difficult for breeders to capture. Pursuing this challenging prize, Crystal Rose crossed a Watermelon Zkittlez female with his Pie Eyed male. Growing similarly to its paternal lineage, our pheno displays average height and symmetrical branching. The flowers exhibit the maternal traits of the Zkittlez lineage, but with the added luster of Pie Eyed’s abundant trichome coverage. Resinous buds emit sugary-sweet watermelon and strawberry aromas, akin to a frozen tropical drink. After curing, a creamy undertone emerges to complement the candy-like layers of mellow watermelon and ripe strawberry, giving the strain its unique moniker, Watermelon Otai. (If you’re not familiar with “otai”-style drinks, you’re not alone! This Polynesian drink, originating in Tonga, combines coconut water, coconut milk, and tropical fruits such as mango, pineapple, and, almost always, watermelon). 

In Live Hash Rosin, the creaminess is exchanged for a more gassy profile which merges with those old-fashioned hard candy flavors. Delivering stress-melting effects that parallel Pie Eyed, Watermelon Otai’s tranquil, transporting relief is an on-demand tropical vacation.

Flavor and effects
The defining character is sweet strawberry and berry flavor with a smooth, refreshing finish. Canna Caviar positions it as a botanical-terpene blend: premium distillate flavored with natural botanical terpenes, intended to provide a discreet experience with little or no conventional cannabis aroma.

Expect a light, balanced cerebral lift rather than a heavy, sedating effect. The brand describes its botanical line—including Caviar Sunrise—as uplifting, relaxed, happy, and clear-headed, while a dispensary listing specifically calls Sunrise a strawberry-flavored sativa suited to a bright, energizing mood.

Caviar Sunrise may appeal to someone seeking a flavorful vape for socializing, creative activities, or daytime relaxation without an intensely pungent scent. For example, it could fit a weekend walk, casual gathering, or low-key creative session better than a nighttime, couch-lock-oriented product.

Because its THC level is high, start with a small inhalation and wait before taking more—especially if you have a low tolerance. Effects can vary by individual, dose, and product batch.

Garden Greens’ listing also highlights limonene and beta-caryophyllene, which points to a mix of bright citrus lift and grounded spice in the background. In terms of effect, Chem 51 is usually described as strong, sleepy, and anti-inflammatory, making it better suited for winding down than for staying sharply active. Overall, Chem 51 is a bold, old-school-leaning modern hybrid for consumers who want serious gas, high potency, and a calming finish.

The flower is typically dense, frosty, and visually striking, with bright green buds, purple accents, and vivid orange hairs. That polished look gives it strong bag appeal and makes it feel like a premium craft selection.

In terms of effects, Jersey Runtz is often described as balanced and enjoyable, starting with an upbeat, happy headspace before easing into a calm, relaxed body feel. It can be a good choice for people who want something flavorful and smooth without feeling overly heavy too soon.

Overall, Garden Greens’ Jersey Runtz delivers a well-rounded mix of sweetness, aroma, and relaxation. It’s the kind of strain that appeals to consumers who like dessert-style cannabis with a lively, approachable finish.

Dominant terpenes including beta-caryophyllene, limonene, and beta-myrcene add peppery, citrus, herbal, and earthy character.

Peanut Butter Cup delivers an authentic, nutty aroma that smells remarkably like a scoop of creamy, rich peanut butter mixed with sweet vanilla and a touch of candy sweetness. Breaking apart the dense, resin-coated nugs releases a sharp undertone of herbal spice and pungent earth. On the exhale, the smoke is thick and smooth, leaving a distinct nutty, sweet, and lightly toasted cookie dough flavor lingering on the palate. This cultivar packs a heavy "couch-lock" potential best saved for nighttime routines, lazy weekends, or a deep movie marathon. Shortly after, its heavy physical traits roll in, sending a deeply calming warmth across your muscles to melt away physical tension, stress, and chronic aches. It is widely favored as an elite sleep-aid or end-of-day recovery strain.

The taste of Red Hotz is just like its namesake treat, with a sweet and sugary berry candy taste accented by zesty, spicy oranges and a hint of fresh red fruits. The aroma is very similar, with a spicy, peppery orange overtone accented by hints of earthiness and a touch of sweet fruity red candies. The Red Hotz high will wash over you quickly, filling your mind with a soaring sense of bright energy. You'll feel utterly euphoric and super creative, ready to get to work on anything artistic at hand. These effects will grow and grow with no ceiling, which can aggravate anxiety at times. In combination with its super high 20-25% average THC level, these effects make Red Hotz a great option for treating experienced patients with a variety of conditions including chronic fatigue, chronic pain, chronic stress or PTSD, nausea and depression or mood swings. This bud has fluffy and oversized, rounded forest green nugs with dark amber undertones, thin dark amber hairs and a frosty coating of tiny, sparkling gold-tinted white crystal trichomes.

Recent lab results put limonene at the top of its terpene profile, bringing a bright, zesty citrus note, followed by myrcene, with an earthy, ripe-fruit depth, and linalool, which adds a soft, floral lavender tone. That mix is what you smell when the package opens and what carries through on the inhale and exhale. Beyond THC, testing also shows measurable CBG and CBGA, minor cannabinoids that round out the overall profile. 

Hybrids usually land between sativa and indica and are often described as balanced, happy and easygoing. Being a hybrid, it works for a wide range of plans, from game night and cooking dinner to simply unwinding after work. Light the tip evenly while rotating, take slow draws, and let it rest between pulls so it burns clean and even. A multi-pack is easy to share or to spread across several sessions, and each joint stays fresh until you open it.

999.desc:
The Human Grade Full Weld Terp Bubble Slurper Banger delivers high-efficiency performance in a seamless, durable design. Featuring a full weld construction, this banger connects the bucket and neck as one continuous piece of quartz, improving airflow, heat distribution, and overall durability. The upgraded terp slurper design includes a bubble chamber that enhances concentrate movement, encouraging better circulation and even vaporization.

The dish-style base includes slits that draw melted oil into the lower chamber, where it swirls through the bubble chamber for complete vaporization. Paired with the included marble and terp pearls, this setup maximizes flavor, movement, and efficiency with every dab. Available in 10mm or 14mm male joints and a 90° angle, it’s an ideal choice for users who want top-tier performance and long-lasting reliability.

1000.desc:
Banana Pie infused pre-rolls take the rich, nostalgic taste of banana cream pie and elevate it with premium flower. Each pre-roll is infused with our signature Banana Pie terpene oil, blending the tropical sweetness of ripe bananas with waves of warm vanilla custard and a whisper of flaky pastry. As you draw in, notes of candied banana swirl into creamy undertones, instantly transporting you to a sunlit bakery counter.

Beneath that dessert-like flavor, the terpene lineup guides the mood from the first inhale onward. Limonene injects a burst of uplifting energy, while Caryophyllene’s gentle spice adds a cozy warmth. Terpinolene brings a touch of floral clarity, and Myrcene’s earthy musk soothes the senses. Humulene rounds out the profile with subtle herbal depth, smoothing the journey into a clear-headed ease.

As the experience settles, a soft sweetness lingers, leaving you in a contented, buoyant state. Banana Pie pre-rolls shine during leisurely afternoons spent with friends, quiet moments of inspiration, or simply whenever you’re craving a sweet pick-me-up.

1001.desc: Bananas Foster Caramels 100mg by Illicit bring rich, dessert-inspired indulgence to your edible experience. Each pack contains 10 creamy caramels infused with 10mg of hybrid THC, offering a smooth and balanced effect perfect for day or night. With the classic flavor of warm bananas, brown sugar, and buttery sweetness, these caramels are a decadent treat that hits just right—whether you're relaxing, socializing, or elevating your mood.

1002.desc:
Lemon Drop invites you to savor the essence of a sun-soaked summer with every inhale. This premium cannabis-infused distillate vape cartridge captures the perfect balance of sour and sweet, reminiscent of a freshly picked ripe lemon. The invigorating aroma of sharp, juicy citrus mingles with delightful candy undertones, creating a tantalizing scent that awakens the senses and sets the stage for a memorable experience.

The flavor profile of Lemon Drop is a vibrant celebration of citrusy brilliance. Each puff delivers a burst of zesty lemon paired with the sugary sweetness of your favorite candies, creating a mouth-puckering sensation that is both refreshing and indulgent. Enhanced by its terpene trio—Limonene, Pinene, and Terpinene—this vape cartridge offers layers of complexity. Limonene provides a bright citrus zest that uplifts the palate, while Pinene adds a subtle piney undertone for depth. Terpinene contributes a floral and herbal nuance, ensuring a smooth and well-rounded flavor journey that delights with every draw.

Experience a surge of energized inspiration with Lemon Drop, perfect for moments when you seek a creative spark or a boost of positivity. The uplifting effects invigorate the mind, fostering a sense of motivation and enthusiasm that enhances productivity and creative pursuits. Whether you're diving into an artistic project, enjoying a lively conversation, or embracing a day of exploration, Lemon Drop delivers a vibrant and uplifting high that keeps you inspired and engaged. Let Lemon Drop elevate your mood and ignite your creativity, making every moment brighter.

1003.desc:
Take a sip of Illicit’s Mojito, the exhilarating cannabis distillate vape that encapsulates the essence of this classic cocktail in every puff. Crafted with precision and expertise, this vape cartridge offers a refreshing burst of flavor reminiscent of a tropical getaway. With each inhale, experience the zesty tang of freshly squeezed lime, invigorating your senses with a burst of citrusy brightness.

As the vapor dances across your palate, refreshing mint emerges, cooling and revitalizing with each exhale. Picture yourself lounging on a sun-drenched beach, sipping on a chilled mojito as the flavors mingle and transport you to paradise. Perfect for unwinding after a long day or adding a touch of tropical flair to any occasion, Mojito promises a vaping experience that's both invigorating and uplifting. Treat yourself to the refreshing taste of Mojito and let its vibrant flavors whisk you away to a blissful state of relaxation.

Our distillate cartridges are born from the coldest of methods using high-quality flowers and high-quality equipment which creates the highest quality of oil. This golden nectar is never diluted with fillers or stuff that doesn’t belong in a vape cartridge. Illicit Labs distillate is for those who crave a little flavor and fun with their method of medicating.

Clementine is a Sativa-dominant hybrid strain (70% Sativa and 30% Indica). First created by cannabis breeders Crockett Family Farms, Clementine is a mixture of Tangie x Lemon Skunk, resulting in citrusy and tangy flavors that are perfect for any sweet tooth. 

This strain is known for being used as remedies for many chronic health issues, such as lack of appetite, anxiety, nausea, fatigue, and depression. 

Similarly, the Clementine strain is excellent for boosting energy, gaining focus, and feeling euphoric. As a result, it’s one of the top cannabis strains for increasing your body’s energy levels.

Not only that, but it packs an uplifting and energetic buzz, leaving users feeling energized and focused with its light mental stimulation.

The moment you take your first puff of Dawg Lemons, your creative juices start to flow and the ideas begin to come. Every sense seems heightened, as you are drawn into a blissful state of motivation. You suddenly find yourself getting lost in thoughts and moments of clarity, each one more potent than the last. As the uplifting high radiates through your body and your mind, you feel ready to take on anything that comes your way.

Whether you're trying to finish a project, have an engaging conversation, or simply let your creativity fly free, Dawg Lemons provides the spark that will bring your imagination to life. Its heady effects create a dynamic atmosphere for innovation and exploration, allowing you to delve deep into the realm of creativity. For a blissful and inspiring journey, Dawg Lemons will surely be the fuel you need to get you there.

1007.desc:
Dr. Funkenstein, also known as "Dr. Funk," is an indica-dominant hybrid strain cultivated by Royal King Seeds. Born from the legendary union of Blueberry and Bubba Kush, this strain captures the best qualities of its renowned parentage. Dr. Funkenstein offers a flavorful journey that delights the palate with a blend of sweet berry notes and earthy sharpness, reflecting its rich genetic heritage.

The strain's primary terpene profile includes Myrcene, Pinene, and Caryophyllene, contributing to its distinctive flavors and effects. Myrcene enhances the sweet, fruity aroma and promotes a sense of relaxation. Pinene introduces subtle pine undertones that can uplift and refresh the senses, while Caryophyllene adds a spicy hint that elevates the overall taste experience. This harmonious combination results in a flavor profile featuring berry, blueberry, cheesy, and sweet notes that make each encounter with Dr. Funkenstein uniquely enjoyable.

Dr. Funkenstein is celebrated for inducing a multifaceted experience that pleasantly envelops both mind and body. Users often report an onset of euphoria and cerebral stimulation, fostering feelings of happiness and creativity. As the journey continues, it gradually transitions into a powerful body sensation that promotes deep relaxation and a laid-back state. This progression may lead to increased appetite and a gentle inclination toward introspection, accompanied by a soothing, sleepy feeling. Drawing from its Blueberry and Bubba Kush lineage, Dr. Funkenstein offers a well-rounded experience that balances uplifting mental effects with calming physical relaxation.

1008.desc:
GMO Cookies is a potent indica hybrid strain developed by Mamiko Seeds, born from the powerful cross of Girl Scout Cookies and Chemdog. Despite its name, GMO Cookies is not a genetically modified organism but a masterful blend of two legendary strains. This variety is celebrated for its unique flavor profile, featuring strong aromas of diesel, coffee, and fruit, with subtle hints of garlic, mushroom, and onion (GMO) inherited from its Chemdog lineage.

The strain's complex terpene profile includes Limonene, Caryophyllene, Myrcene, Humulene, and Bisabolol, contributing to its distinctive flavors and effects. Limonene adds a touch of citrus that uplifts the senses, while Caryophyllene introduces spicy notes that enhance the earthy and pungent aroma. Myrcene brings musky and herbal undertones, promoting a sense of relaxation. Humulene adds subtle earthy and woody flavors, and Bisabolol imparts gentle floral hints that round out the overall taste experience. This harmonious combination results in an earthy, pungent flavor with diesel overtones that linger on the palate.

GMO Cookies is renowned for its deeply relaxing effects that envelop the body while allowing the mind to remain focused. Users often report feeling relaxed, happy, and uplifted, enjoying a long-lasting high that soothes both mind and body. Drawing from its Girl Scout Cookies lineage, it offers euphoric and uplifting sensations that enhance mood and promote happiness. The Chemdog heritage contributes to the potent body relaxation, providing a soothing experience without total sedation. This balanced blend makes GMO Cookies a favorite among those seeking mental clarity paired with physical tranquility.

1009.desc: Illicit Gummies Fruit Punch'd delivers a vibrant burst of tropical sweetness, blending tangy citrus and ripe berry flavors that dance on the tongue like a juicy summer breeze. Each gummy packs a potent punch, offering a perfect balance of indulgence and euphoria.

1010.desc:
Lemon Tree Punch combines the sweet-and-sour tang of Lemon Tree and the fruity fragrance of Purple Punch. This variety smells strongly of lemon, grape, and berry, mixed with undertones of diesel fuel and wet soil. Lemon Tree Punch offers a rich flavor that is particularly complex. Depending on the phenotype, some plants may taste more of grape and berry, and others may be more citrusy. 

Lemon Tree Punch provides a balanced effect that is both stimulating and comforting. Users report that this strain boosts the mood and increases motivation when it is consumed in small doses. When consumed in greater quantities, this invigorating effect shifts into a mildly sedating stone that may reduce muscle tension and soothe the mind. Given its well-balanced effects, Lemon Tree Punch makes for a great all-day smoke.

1011.desc: Max AC stands as a pinnacle of hybrid ingenuity, brought to life by Greenpoint Genetics through an inspired cross of MAC 1 and Animal Cookies. This strain captures the essence of two powerhouse genetics, blending the resin-rich, robust character of MAC 1 with the flavor-forward, distinctive profile of Animal Cookies. The result is a hybrid that delivers a compelling fusion of clear-headed euphoria and soothing physical calm, tailored for those seeking both mental spark and grounded relaxation.

1012.desc:
Mintlato is a hybrid born of Animal Mints and Gelato 41, showcasing a terpene cast led by limonene, caryophyllene, humulene, myrcene, and pinene. At first draw, limonene brings a bright citrus zing that awakens the senses, while pinene’s fresh pine notes add a brisk clarity. Myrcene’s earthy, musky undertones lend a plush, soothing backdrop, and caryophyllene’s spicy warmth weaves through the mix, rounding out the flavor with a subtle peppery edge. Humulene’s herbal whisper ties everything together, creating a complex, mint-tinged profile that feels both crisp and luxuriant.

Onset is marked by a light uplift—limonene promotes a buoyant sense of optimism, lifting the spirit without racing the mind. As that initial glow settles, myrcene and humulene ease the body into gentle relaxation, melting away tension without heavy sedation. Pinene’s clarity helps maintain focus, keeping thoughts crisp even as a comfortable calm washes over you. The result is a balanced high that can fuel creative bursts, spark conversation, or simply enhance a lazy afternoon with a refreshing twist.

With its harmonious interplay of invigorating and soothing notes, Mintlato invites you to explore a variety of activities. Tackle a brainstorming session with newfound clarity, lose yourself in mellow music with a relaxed frame of mind, or savor a quiet moment of reflection as the minty breeze lingers on your palate - Mintlato adapts to your mood, amplifying joy and composure in equal measure.

Sunset Frost Cookies merges the sugary decadence of Sunset Sherbet with the potent, savory depth of GMO Cookies, creating a hybrid that embodies balance in both flavor and effect. From the first inhale, this strain delivers an intricate blend of sweet citrus, creamy vanilla, and earthy spice. Its aroma evokes a twilight moment in a summer garden: rich, fragrant, and soothingly warm. Each draw reveals new layers of complexity, with notes of fruit and spice melting into a velvety, dessert-like finish that lingers on the palate.

The terpene blend of Limonene, Myrcene, Caryophyllene, Linalool, Humulene, and Bisabolol shapes both the experience and its nuanced aroma. Limonene brings a bright citrus clarity that energizes the senses, while Myrcene adds depth with its musky, grounding essence. Caryophyllene contributes a subtle peppery warmth that enriches the sweetness, as Linalool lends a soft floral calm. The addition of Humulene and Bisabolol rounds out the bouquet with woody and honeyed undertones, giving the strain a signature aroma that’s both uplifting and soothing.

The effects of Sunset Frost Cookies unfold like a slow sunset, beginning with a wave of euphoria that lifts the mind before easing into a serene, full-body calm. The cerebral clarity encourages mellow conversation or introspection, while the physical relaxation melts away lingering tension without sedation. Perfect for winding down the day or embracing a peaceful evening, Sunset Frost Cookies offers a luxurious balance of sweetness, depth, and calm - an indulgent hybrid that delivers on every note.

Lily Extract's fully ceramic cartridges provide you a consistent and quality hit for all of your solventless extract!

Live rosin is a solventless cannabis concentrate made from fresh-frozen cannabis plants. Frozen plants are placed in a rosin press, which uses heat and pressure to extract a hot oil from the plants, which is rosin. The “live” in live rosin means frozen plants were used as the source material; when dried cannabis plant material is used, it is just rosin.

Live rosin is a solventless cannabis concentrate made from fresh-frozen cannabis plants. Frozen plants are placed in a rosin press, which uses heat and pressure to extract a hot oil from the plants, which is rosin. The “live” in live rosin means frozen plants were used as the source material; when dried cannabis plant material is used, it is just rosin.

Peak Pro Link lets you bring Peak Pro performance to your favorite glass rig—so you can ditch torches, timers, and guessing temps. It connects your Peak Pro base to a banger-style setup and uses real-time temperature control with customizable heat settings for bigger clouds and bold flavor at the push of a button. It’s an easy way to give new life to glass you already love, with compatibility for Peak Pro 3D and 3DXL Chambers (Peak Pro and chambers sold separately).

Cleaning & Care:
> Chamber: Swab after each dab; deep clean with 90%+ isopropyl alcohol and let fully air-dry before heating.

> Link parts: Let everything cool completely. Clean the metal elbow, silicone joints, and stand with 90%+ ISO (you can soak elbow/joints for 20–30 minutes). Use an ISO-dipped swab on contact points. Do not soak the entire Link in ISO.

> If you see a red/white connection error, update firmware and clean connection pins.

The VEAZY Vaporizer is the perfect blend of performance, portability, and style, built on decades of expertise in vaporization technology. Our smallest and most accessible device ever – yet unmistakably S&B.

Heating System: The Veazy uses a patented combination of convection and conduction heating, which delivers dense, flavorful vapor from dry herbs.

Portability: It is the smallest and lightest vaporizer from Storz & Bickel, weighing just 134 grams (0.3 lb), making it highly pocketable and ideal for on-the-go use.

Materials & Build Quality: Constructed with medical-grade PEEK plastic and a ceramic-coated filling chamber, the Veazy is designed for durability and safe performance.

Bold, complex, and intensely aromatic. It greets the nose with a sweet, juicy fruit and cherry character, cutting through a heavy mid-palate of skunky, savory fuel and finishing with a grounding layer of earthy herbal spice and woody pine.

The sativa-dominant profile delivers floral and sweet flavor notes with hints of citrus that dance across the palate with each draw. 1964.desc:
All the flavor you could possibly want, with nothing you don’t. Just pure live resin in a convenient, instant format.This super-unique in-house creation sports some eye-popping terpene numbers and an exceedingly rare pinene-dominant profile.

This one potentially provides a clear-headed, invigorating uplift that truly stands out from most modern cannabis. This one is best experienced with friends, in the sunshine, having a wonderful time.

1965.desc:
Superflux’s Purp Paya is a 3.5g pack of indica-hybrid pre-ground flower infused with live resin for a richer, terpene-forward experience.

The live resin is extracted from flash-frozen fresh-harvest cannabis, a process designed to preserve a robust profile of the plant’s natural terpenes and cannabinoids before being infused into the ground flower.

The result is a more concentrated, flavorful take on traditional ground flower, with enhanced potency and a deeper terpene character.

1966.desc:
Rainbow Belts 2.0 itself is a hybrid cultivar derived from crosses like Moonbow × Zkittlez with a reputation for fruity, candy-sweet aromas and rich terpene character.

Typical flavor notes reported for this strain in live resin form include:
> Sweet fruity candy vibes
> Bright citrus and tropical top notes
> Earthy or gas undertones depending on batch and terpene preservation

Effects:
> Relaxation and body calm
> Mild euphoria with a sweet, candy-like inhale
> Some users describe it as a more chill, indica-leaning experience rather than cerebral or energetic (especially with indica-leaning hybrids).

Consuming this strain will unleash aromas of zesty, citrusy lemon candies accented by fresh fruits and nutty cookies. The flavor is even more delicious, with a zesty lemon candy overtone accented by touches of light diesel.

The Yuzu Sour high will hit you quickly, infusing your mind with a near-instant rush of bright energy and euphoria. You'll feel super happy and outgoing, although not at all focused, at this point, filled with a sociability that inspires you to get chatting. A light touch of physical calm comes next, wrapping its way around you and leaving you feeling pain-free but still energized. These effects give Yuzu Sour an edge in treating a variety of conditions including chronic stress or anxiety, chronic fatigue, depression or mood swings and chronic pain.

Our indoor farm is a controlled environment built for cultivating organic, high-quality cannabis in a sustainable way.

Segmented into multiple grow rooms, our plants thrive under an advanced LED lighting system that provides the perfect spectrum of light, promoting photosynthesis and energy efficiency. A light lifting system further enhances light intensity and proximity to the canopy, optimizing our energy consumption and our commitment to sustainability.

A precise climate control system maintains ideal temperature, humidity, and C02 levels - creating an environment in which our plants thrive. When you enter our grow rooms, the air is enriched with the smell of the living soil and organic nutrients, supporting a healthy ecosystem for beneficial microbes. We employ organic pest management techniques, using beneficial insects and natural solutions to avoid harmful chemicals, adhering to strict organic standards. Designed with sustainability in mind, our farm features water-efficient irrigation and a comprehensive waste recycling program.

Attention to detail is evident in every cultivation stage, from the nursery to harvesting, with knowledgeable growers monitoring each plant's progress. In the processing area, our team meticulously trims and processes buds, ensuring each product meets our high standards of quality.

Our farm represents a commitment to quality cannabis and responsible agriculture. We produce premium cannabis that reflects our dedication to health, the environment, and our community.
